about_item: Perfect pots with saucers and drainage holes for both modern and classic interiors, they give any room a stylish look. Ideal for private homes and places like offices, restaurants, receptions, and many other premises of classic, representative style. Great for indoor green plants, herbs, and flowers such as orchids, roses, succulents, cactuses, ferns etc.

Our round plant pots are available in 25 colours and 6 small, medium, large sizes, mix match and play with style. You can combine your plants according to your personal taste using as many pots as you need. Each pot has very modern and unique, eye-catching design perfect for any plant, flower composition

6 sizes 12 CM POT 12 cm height, 12.6 cm top diameter, 11 cm bottom diameter, 11 cm depth 14 CM POT 13.5cm height, 15.5 cm top diameter, 12.5 cm bottom diameter, 12.5 depth 16 CM POT 15.2 cm height, 16 cm top diameter, 13.9 bottom diameter, 13.9 cm depth 18 CM POT 17.8 cm height, 18.5 cm top diameter, 16 cm bottom diameter, 16 cm depth 21 CM POT 20.8 cm height, 21.5 cm top diameter, 18,7 bottom diameter, 19 cm depth 26 CM POT 25.8 cm height, 26.4 cm top diameter, 23 cm bottom, 24 cm depth

Drainage holes and saucer. Each pot has drainage holes and saucer attached to the bottom by pins. Saucer can be removed when needed. Except for a few aquatic plants, plant roots don’t like to sit in water. They need to exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide with the air, and excess water closes off the air pockets in soil. Plants in pots without drainage holes are prone to becoming overwatered. Even if the soil surface appears dry, the soil at the bottom of the pot may be sopping wet.

Flowerpots with stand created for long-lasting. Made from sturdy, durable plastic, resistant to distortion and very light. Classic round shape. Aesthetic, easy to clean and suitable for all interiors, they beautifully emphasize the values of plants. Flowerpots from the Decor series with an integrated saucer have beautiful and elegant look which attracts the eye. Simple forms harmonize well with various styles of interior design.
